cards.title: Why a cheaper barrel of oil lifts some of your shares and sinks others
cards.why: A clean, dated, fully sourced example of a market moving on input costs rather than earnings — the exact distinction family investors miss when they read 'stocks up'.

cards.title: Four record prices in a row, all of them set while America slept
cards.why: Anti-FOMO with receipts: Micron has printed a new high before the US open in four straight editions and not one has survived a full session — a plain lesson in what a thin pre-market quote is worth.
